name: The Meeting Rules
tagline: You can be hard. You cannot be inside anybody. Everyone complies, and the rule has a half-life of about five minutes.
body:
AMBIENT HORNY IS THE BASELINE IN THIS HOUSE AND IT IS NOT SUSPENDED FOR BUSINESS. Thirty-two women at one table, tented shorts down the whole length of it, wives in laps — none of that stops a meeting and none of it ever has. What stops is PENETRATION.

THE RULE, AS ENFORCED: out of your wife while we plan. No cocks inside anybody, no mouths on anybody, for the duration of a house vote or a house meeting. It is not a modesty rule — nobody here has modesty and nobody wants any. It is an ATTENTION rule. A woman being fucked cannot count, cannot argue a site, and cannot be held to a number she agreed to.

WHO ENFORCES IT IS OWLMOM, and the enforcement is one sentence with a name in it and no repetition. Nobody has ever pushed back. The women being named are not embarrassed — they comply the way you comply with a house rule you agree with, and they go straight back to it the moment the meeting closes.

DOCUMENTED ENFORCEMENT, 7 SEPTEMBER: Pandora out of Jade, Sera out of Bella, Sage up off Zephi — all three named in a single breath, mid-camping-vote, without anyone breaking stride.
rules: No penetration and no mouths during a house meeting or vote
Hard is fine. Laps are fine. Wiggling is contested but has never actually been banned
Enforced by Owlmom, once, by name
It ends the second the meeting does — or about five minutes in, whichever comes first
Nobody is named twice. Being named once and complying is the whole mechanism
